title: 嗶不過的閘門
subject: a commuter whose transit card fails at the same metro ticket gate every morning, and the station attendant who starts waiting by that gate to wave him through, until he buys a new card and walks to her window anyway
caption: Mandarin doo-wop, 1950s street-corner style in 12/8 feel. Four-part male backing harmonies on nonsense syllables, piano triplet chords, walking upright bass, light brushed drums, a short tenor sax solo. Warm mono-style room sound with slight tape echo and a close harmony stack. Male high tenor lead, earnest crooning with a soft falsetto break. 76 BPM, E-flat major. Sweet, shy and lightly comic. No trap beats, no autotune, no EDM, no modern R&B runs, no rock guitars.
lyrics:
[Intro - doo-wop harmonies, piano triplets, brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
每天早上七點四十
第三個閘門嗶不過
紅燈一亮我就臉紅
後面排了一條長龍

[Pre-Chorus]
穿制服的妳走過來
一刷就讓我過去

[Chorus]
嗶不過的閘門
每天都等我出糗
嗶不過的閘門
讓我多看妳一眼

[Verse 2]
後來妳乾脆站在旁邊
我還沒到妳就笑了
妳說這張卡該換了
我說再等一等

[Bridge - sax solo then harmonies]
今天我買了新的卡
嗶一聲就過了
可是我又走回來
站在妳的窗口前

[Chorus]
嗶不過的閘門
今天輪到我說話
新的卡在我口袋
我想問妳幾點下班

[Outro - harmonies hum, piano triplets fade]
